messages:
elena_marketing: Heads up — weekly KPI deck showing sessions down 18% MoM but MQLs are up 27%. dashboard alert flagged a huge jump in 'organic' channel conversions. Anybody else seeing this? :thinking:

mike_analytics: I pulled the raw GA export. There's a spike in the 'source' dimension set to 'referral (unknown)'. looks like UTM parsing got weird for a subset of leads. no major traffic spike from paid.

sam_growth: We pushed the webinar landing page last Wednesday with a new redirect flow. @anya_ops did we change the UTM template?

anya_ops: We updated the GTM tag to handle the redirect, but I intentionally left campaign params to be passed through. I did change one redirect to strip query params to keep the URL clean — could be that.

mike_analytics: aha — stripping query params would drop UTM_source/campaign and GA will attribute to organic/referral by default. I can detect which sessions came from that path.

elena_marketing: Oof. That would explain webinar leads counting as organic and the skew in channel conversion rates. Can we identify how many MQLs came through that page?

mike_analytics: Running a query now. Short answer: ~142 MQLs in the last week tied to that redirect path. If we reassign them to 'webinar' campaign the channel mix normalizes.

sam_growth: That matches what we saw in HubSpot — sudden MQL spike after the push. Are those leads routing correctly into the webinar nurture? I saw some landed in the main SDR queue.

anya_ops: Yes, around ~30 leads hit the default pipeline because the form POST lacked the hidden field our routing rules depend on (the redirect stripped it). I created a rollback and re-pushed a fix at 11:22am.

ken_product: Quick Q — did we lose any attribution to partner referrals? We have a partner co-promote for that webinar.

mike_analytics: Partner utm_medium was present on the initial invite link, but the redirect chain replaced it. For partner attribution we should mark those 48 leads as partner manually and run a reconciliation.

elena_marketing: Action items: 1) @anya_ops confirm rollback fully live and form fields preserved (done?) 2) @mike_analytics export list of affected lead IDs and suggested attribution fixes 3) @sam_growth update campaign dashboard with corrected numbers and note change in weekly deck. I'll patch notes in the KPI slide.

anya_ops: Rollback live and verified. Form fields preserved on test submits.

mike_analytics: Export ready: attaching CSV to the ticket. I'll also push a GA reclassification mapping and a short writeup on how this shows up in reports.

jira_bot: Ticket MARK-612 created: "webinar redirect stripped UTMs -> attribution mismatch" assigned to anya_ops, mike_analytics, sam_growth. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MARK-612

sam_growth: Thanks. For the weekly KPI review tomorrow, should we show both raw and corrected metrics so leadership knows why the change happened? :+1:

elena_marketing: Yes — show raw, corrected, and a short footnote describing the GTM/redirect bug and remediation. Also include partner reconciliation numbers.

mike_analytics: I'll add a small sensitivity table (with/without corrected webinar leads) so the CAC and conversion rates are transparent.

elena_marketing: Great. Closing the loop here — will update the KPI deck and ping you when it's ready for review. :raised_hands:

sam_growth: 👍
